toolsPreview.name: render_mindmap
toolsPreview.description: Render an interactive MCP app mind map when the user needs hierarchical structure shown visually instead of as prose. Use it for breaking down ideas, plans, study material, or systems into a root topic with nested branches; do not use it for tables, flowcharts, Mermaid/Graphviz diagrams, or plain text lists. Input `mindmap_markdown` must be a clean markdown tree with one `#` root heading and 2-space-indented bullet nesting. If the user gives prose, first reshape it into that hierarchy, then call this tool.
